title: The Widow's War
logline: The matriarch of a powerful smuggling family has died, and her three children are threatening to tear the sector apart in a war of succession.

roles.description: Brutal, traditional, believes might makes right.
Cunning, deceitful, prefers poison to blasters.
Naive, idealistic, completely unfit for a life of crime.
A vast network of illegal trade routes currently frozen in panic.
Opportunistic raiders picking off the family's assets.

public_situation: The feared matriarch of the {role:smuggling_syndicate} has passed, and her children are openly feuding for the throne.
private_truth: The matriarch's legendary black book of blackmail material is missing, and whoever finds it controls the syndicate.

beats.public_change: The siblings issue competing bounties for the recovery of their mother's personal effects.

missions.reason: The youngest heir hires the pilot to trade for the black book from a corrupt vault guard.
missions.private_fact: The youngest heir intends to destroy the book and legitimize the family business.

beats.public_change: The older siblings realize the book is in play and intercept the pilot.

missions.reason: The eldest heir demands the pilot deliver the book to them, promising a fortune in raw credits.
missions.private_fact: The eldest will use it to purge all rivals violently.

missions.reason: The middle heir counters, demanding the book in exchange for blackmail material on the pilot.
missions.private_fact: The middle heir will use it to weave an unbreakable web of extortion.

beats.public_change: While the family fights, a rival gang swoops in to destroy the stronghold.

missions.reason: The youngest heir begs the pilot to defend the stronghold from the rival gang so they can burn the book in peace.
missions.private_fact: Destroying the book will cripple the syndicate's power forever.

player_choice.prompt: The stronghold is safe. The pilot can let the youngest burn the book, or walk away and let the family tear itself apart.

options.label: Let the youngest heir burn the book
Keep the book and walk away

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the book to the eldest heir.
resolutions.summary: The eldest heir unleashes a wave of assassinations, cementing their rule in blood. The syndicate becomes a brutal cartel.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the book to the middle heir.
resolutions.summary: The middle heir quietly assumes control. Sector officials start resigning inexplicably as the syndicate's invisible grip tightens.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps the youngest heir burn the book.
resolutions.summary: Without the blackmail, the syndicate shatters into dozens of petty gangs. The youngest heir tries to start a legitimate shipping company.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot burned the biggest blackmail ledger in the sector, and half the politicians breathed a sigh of relief.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot steals the book or abandons the youngest heir.
resolutions.summary: The family war drags on for years, devastating local trade, and the black book changes hands again and again.

loose_threads.detail: A doctor mentions the matriarch didn't die of old age; her heart stopped instantly from a localized EMP pacemaker burst.
Three pages of the black book were cleanly excised before the pilot even found it.

radio_hooks: Infamous smuggling matriarch dead; authorities brace for gang war.
Bounties spike across the sector as {role:smuggling_syndicate} infighting escalates.

voice_direction.middle_heir: Smooth, silky, always sounds slightly amused.
voice_direction.youngest_heir: Earnest, pleading, desperately trying to do the right thing.
